editorial:
Five college best friends reunite in Miami for a wild bachelorette weekend, and things go sideways fast when a male stripper accidentally dies during the party. What starts as a fun night turns into a frantic cover-up that tests their friendship in the funniest ways. The group has great chemistry, and the energy stays high from start to finish. You will laugh at the chaos even when the plot gets a little messy. The Miami setting adds to the party vibe and keeps things lively.

Scarlett Johansson leads a strong cast, and the jokes land often, though some miss the mark. The movie is not perfect, but the laughs and heart make it worth your time. If you enjoy dark comedy with friends, this one delivers big. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for movie night with your crew.
endingExplained: The friends discover the stripper was not a real dancer but a thief trying to rob them. After a wild night of hiding the body and dodging police, they learn the truth and clear their names. The wedding goes ahead as planned, and the group's bond is stronger than ever. The final twist reveals the dead man was part of a bigger scam, turning their nightmare into a funny reunion story.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedy and friend group chaos.
